description: Record money the business received for a booking: cash, a POS card payment, or a bank transfer. A held bank-transfer booking is confirmed once enough is recorded. Without confirm: true it only shows what would be recorded (the guest, the balance and what's left after), so you can check with the person first. A recorded payment can't be edited or deleted.

confirm.description: Must be true to actually record it

name: record_payment
title: Record a payment
